Behavior score and rank
15 Nov, 2025 @ 9:55am
chop chop
I’ve been noticing a trend in my matches: players who don’t speak English often end up with lower behavior scores, not necessarily because they’re toxic, but because the coordination and decision-making in those games is all over the place.
The reporting system feels completely unbalanced. If a player has a significantly lower rank or a much lower behavior score than you, they shouldn’t have the same reporting power. A 2000 behavior score Herald shouldn’t be able to tank the behavior score of someone who’s trying to play clean.
